_comment: Paths are prefixes, relative to the repo root. A tool call editing a file under ai/ is allowed if the file starts with one of always_allowed or one of phases[<current phase>]. A tool call editing a file OUTSIDE ai/ (i.e. real project code, not always_allowed) is allowed only when the current phase is 'deployment'. In-progress code belongs in ai/code_dev/ instead, gated by the 'development' phase like any other ai/ path.
